implemented_claims: The portable AST compiles deterministically for the seven declared project-authored dialect subsets.
Compiler output can be parsed semantically and recompiled without rendering drift for those declared subsets.
Property tests cover compile, parse and recompile stability across generated terms, truncation and Boolean conjunction or disjunction.
Exact native text and source spans are preserved, and semantic parse failures remain RawOnly with an explicit review-required diagnostic.
The corpus loss matrix binds each conformance claim to its parser and executable property evidence.
external_gates: Accountable methodological and provider-currency review of real named-filter packs.
Accountable independent information-specialist PRESS review of the digest-bound, rights-clear conformance corpus.
claim_boundary: Compiler and test evidence covers only the seven explicitly declared project-authored syntax subsets. It does not establish complete vendor-language support, cross-database retrieval equivalence, real-filter methodological validity or currency, or PRESS approval.
